svg.title: Genièvre — Juniperus communis
svg.desc: A fruiting common juniper twig, with stiff, sharply pointed awl leaves in visible whorls of three. Each sage green needle bears a pale stomatal band. Blue-black fleshy seed cones have a dusty blue wax bloom and minute three-scale seams; a single olive green cone is still immature. Fine curved engraving follows the needles and reddish grey bark.
